description: Read what signals detected (created with create_signal): new posts, comments, reactions, profile views, connection changes and Sales Navigator list alerts, one page at a time. Always pass since – the nextSince of your previous call – to read only what is new. Without since the tool reads the last 24 hours; pass an older since only when you need older events (they are kept 90 days). Returns { since, events, hasMore, nextSince }: since is the moment the page starts after; the page holds the earliest events recorded after it, listed newest first; nextSince is the newest detectedAt in the page. When hasMore is true, call again with since = nextSince for the next page – nothing is skipped or repeated. On a busy account narrow the read with signalId, signalType or eventType. Process each event once by its id. Every event carries signalId, signalType, label, type and detectedAt (when the check recorded it, not when it happened on LinkedIn), plus its subject: post (postPublished, postFound), postUrl and comment (commentAdded), postUrl and reaction (reactionAdded), viewer (profileViewed), personUrn and personUrl (connectionAccepted, connectionAdded, connectionRequestReceived), or alert, subjectUrn and subjectHashedUrl (alertPublished: the alert as nv_retrieve_alerts returns it, and its lead or account as nv_retrieve_list_leads and nv_retrieve_list_accounts return urn and hashedUrl, null when unknown).

eventType.description: Optional. Only events of this type.

signalId.description: Optional. Only events of this signal.

signalType.description: Optional. Only events of signals of this type.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp: return events recorded after it (e.g., '2026-10-12T16:40:00.000Z'). Pass the nextSince of your previous call. Defaults to 24 hours ago.

name: get_signal_events
